What is an Interactive Offer?

The definition

An Interactive Offer is a lead magnet, quiz, assessment, calculator, roadmap, decision tool or mini offer that helps people experience your expertise instead of just reading about it.

During the intensive, you'll build one from start to finish.

Examples of what you could build

🧲

Interactive Lead Magnet

A quiz, tool, or diagnostic that builds your list and actually gets used.

💡

Interactive Mini Offer

A compact, high-value micro-product built from expertise you already have.

🛠️

Decision Tool or Framework

Something your audience can work through and get a real result from.

📊

Calculator or Assessment

An interactive experience that gives them personalised output based on their answers.

the difference

Why interactive offers outperform traditional lead magnets

For the last year, I've been obsessed with one question: how do we create digital assets people actually use? Because growing your list with a passive PDF does grow your list. But if they're not interacting with it, they're not getting to know you, not experiencing what you do, not building trust. Now with Claude, we can create experiences that people actually engage with.

why I'm teaching this

I've spent the last year figuring out why some lead magnets get used and most get ignored.

Most lead magnets get downloaded once and forgotten.

Not because the information is bad. Because passive content is easy to ignore.

Over the last few months, I've been experimenting with a different approach. Using Claude, I've built more than 20 interactive lead magnets, decision tools, calculators, mini offers, and audience-building resources. Some worked brilliantly. Some completely flopped. Every one taught me something.

Through that process, I developed a repeatable framework for turning existing expertise into interactive experiences people actually engage with.

That's the process I'll be teaching inside this intensive. Not theory. Not endless prompting. One finished interactive offer built alongside me over four weeks.

got a question? I've got answers

Before you decide

Do I need a paid Claude account?
The free Claude plan works to get started. A paid Claude Pro plan (around $20/month) is recommended if you're planning to build multiple interactive assets or use Claude heavily during the intensive, but it's not required. We'll cover this in the first session.
What if I'm not techy?
This intensive is designed for people who are good at their work, not necessarily at tech. The templates and walkthroughs do most of the heavy lifting. If you can copy, paste, and follow instructions, you can build what we're building.
What kinds of interactive offers can I build?
Quizzes, diagnostic tools, interactive guides, calculators, mini-courses, resource libraries, decision frameworks, email opt-in experiences, and more. We'll help you identify which format suits your expertise best during Week 1.
Can I use this for client work?
Absolutely. If you work with clients in marketing, coaching, consulting, or content, the skills and templates in this intensive apply directly. Many participants will be building interactive assets they can offer as a service.
Will replays be available?
Yes, every session is recorded and you'll have lifetime access to replays. If you can't make a live session, you won't miss out. The companion guide also walks through everything covered in each call.
Is this beginner friendly?
Yes, with a caveat: it's best suited to people who already have expertise, content, or knowledge they want to package, even if they've never built a digital asset before. If you're brand new to online business, you might want to build a small audience first.
What if I don't have an audience yet?
That's exactly what interactive lead magnets and audience assets are for. They're designed to be shared, discovered, and opted into. You don't need an existing audience to benefit from this intensive, you just need something worth sharing.
